slimNotes: Controlled WorkWise snapshot of PPT Master v4.3.0. Core routing, references, workflows, all 64 top-level Python scripts and their modules, editable SVG/PPTX conversion, preset shapes, confirmation UI, chart templates, brand presets, deck presets, and three curated lightweight examples (SVG output + spec + notes only, no images/final previews/exports/sources) are retained. Large icon and AI-comparison image libraries, user projects, generated exports, backups, and private PPTX files are excluded. requirements.txt and the prompt-audit manifest are WorkWise-maintained overlays; no Pandoc dependency is installed. The frozen sidecar bundles the PPT Master 4.3 Shape Boolean dependencies (pathops/skia-pathops and uharfbuzz). autoUpdate is disabled; a future upgrade requires a new audited snapshot.
